v34_attributes.description: CYC4-007. Puts four iron armor pieces on the caller, inspects attributes, and asserts. Expect ATTRIBUTE name=generic.armor base=0.00 value=15.00 modifiers=4 with four ATTRIBUTE_MODIFIER records named Armor modifier (amounts 2, 5, 6, 2), and ATTRIBUTE name=generic.armorToughness with four Armor toughness modifiers of amount 0.00 under the same four UUIDs; UUIDs appear in lower case. Then ASSERT pass for value 15 and for the boots UUID with amount 2; ASSERT fail tolerated for amount 3; the shared name tolerated as devtool.assert.ambiguous; then the armor removed.
commands: devtool assert attribute @s generic.armor modifier 845DB27C-C624-495F-8C9F-6020A9A58B6B amount 2

commands.command: devtool assert attribute @s generic.armor modifier 845DB27C-C624-495F-8C9F-6020A9A58B6B amount 3
devtool assert attribute @s generic.armor modifier Armor modifier amount 2

v34_not_living.description: CYC4-007. A minecart has no attributes. Expect an ERROR and the inspect failing, then an ERROR and the assert failing, then the cart removed.
